cheapest.verdict: Flamingo Las Vegas, Flamingo Room | 2 Queens: $581 for 7 nights (Feb 15–22, 2027), including a $50/day resort fee, before taxes.
cheapest.runnerUp: South Point, Premium 2 Queens: $989 for the same seven nights including all fees, before taxes.
cheapest.delta: $408 more at South Point for the week. Flamingo is center Strip; South Point is at the south end of the Las Vegas Strip.
cheapest.caveat: These are snapshot rates from one capture. A rate is not a reservation, and taxes are excluded. Caesars Palace itself moved from $226 to $214 per night between 2026-11-26 and 2026-11-27 (F-23), so treat every total as a reading, not a price.

dateVerdict.statement: Among the windows actually captured, Feb 15–22, 2027 is cheaper than the following week at the only hotel that quoted both: South Point charges $989 vs $1,049 for a two-queen room (+$60, about 6%). The March 15–22 window could not be quoted at all because March 20, 2027 shows no availability.
dateVerdict.cannotSay: This is not proof that Feb 15–22 is the cheapest week in the whole window. Only one property produced comparable quotes across windows, and no historical or forward rate series was retrieved. Some March dates are already sold out, which is itself a reason not to wait.

bookTiming.statement: TIME-CRITICAL, VERIFIED 2026-11-27: Wynn's public 'Cyber Exclusive' rate for the exact Feb 15–22 2027 stay is $677 avg/night including the resort fee, versus $833 avg/night on the same room's Flexible Getaway Rate. That offer must be BOOKED between November 20 and December 4, 2026. Booking inside that window saves $1,092 across 7 nights before tax and adds a $75/day resort credit (up to $300 per stay). This is the only verified, dated booking deadline found that changes the price of this specific trip. Separately, no official source publishes an optimal booking lead time, and Caesars advertises 'Advanced Purchase Savings — up to 30% off for stays 30+ days in advance', which booking now already satisfies.

bookTiming.action: Book a refundable/free-cancellation two-queen room now as a hedge, then recheck the same dated engines weekly and rebook if the rate falls. Cancellation terms must be read on the booking page — the 48-hour term was not fully retrieved.

rateCalendar.hotel: Resorts World Las Vegas — Las Vegas Hilton tower
rateCalendar.warning: These are the engine's per-arrival-date 'from' prices for February 2027. The same calendar prints TWO contradictory captions — 'Calendar pricing excludes daily resort fee and taxes' AND 'Calendar pricing includes $55 daily resort fee and excludes taxes' — so fee treatment is UNRESOLVED (F-26). Summing seven consecutive nights is an INDICATIVE comparison of date windows, not a quote.
rateCalendar.finding: Shifting check-in from Mon Feb 15 to Thu Feb 18 lowers the indicative 7-night room subtotal from $1,942 to $1,632 — about $310 (16%) less — and still starts inside the preferred part of the window. Feb 16 and Feb 17 are the two most expensive weeknights of the month at $404 each. Only February was captured; no claim is made about March.

verifiedDateFacts.fact: Monday, February 15, 2027 is Washington's Birthday (Presidents' Day), a U.S. federal holiday.
verifiedDateFacts.effect: Your preferred check-in is the holiday itself, at the end of a three-day weekend.

verifiedDateFacts.fact: MGM Resorts' official engine states stays can only be booked up to 14 nights online; longer stays need 866.761.7111.
verifiedDateFacts.effect: A 14-night trip is exactly the online maximum at MGM properties — no margin.

verifiedDateFacts.fact: Red Rock Canyon requires a timed-entry vehicle reservation 8 AM–5 PM, Oct 1 – May 31.
verifiedDateFacts.effect: Book the Red Rock slot before finalising the daily itinerary.

verifiedDateFacts.fact: Valley of Fire's trail closures run May 15 – Sep 30 and its maintenance closure is Dec 1–14.
verifiedDateFacts.effect: Feb/Mar is one of the best windows of the year — all listed trails are open.
